bin: OreBin round 5 (round 4's furniture, heaped to the wall tops when full, physically settled)
space: Unity prefab space, origin = bin footprint centre on the ground. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.
unit_semantics: SETTLED: every copy has an explicit final pose from a rigid-body simulation (convex-hull items, friction 0.75, restitution 0, damping 0.25/0.45, dropped stack by stack in fill order, earlier stacks frozen). unit.position = centre of unit.box; each copy: place the item's prefab so that its BOUNDS CENTRE sits at unit.position + copy.offset (= copy.world_position, prefab space), rotated by copy.euler (Unity Quaternion.Euler, ZXY) or copy.quat_xyzw, uniform scale copy.scale relative to the item prefab's native size. Item root = bounds centre - R * (scale * item.bounds_center_unity). unit.box = bounding box of the unit's copies, its bottom lowered to the lowest corner of any copy's rotated bounds (so a never-below-the-floor lift leaves the settled heap alone).
fill_order: units are listed in fill order; show the first n (a partial stack: its first k copies). Later stacks lie on earlier ones, earlier stacks never move. Each compartment holds one item type (compartments[]); unit.item is its type, copies keep it.
